## History

Twenty-five years in the past, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) proposed to [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) under a honeysuckle trellis, though their engagement was later broken. After his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), was introduced to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and formed a fond connection with her, [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) reunited with his former love. He subsequently married Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) in the garden at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), surrounded by their guests, before the couple was seen off at the station.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P0](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0000), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P1](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0001), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P2](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0002), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P6](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0006), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P8](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0008), +61 more_

## Relationships

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--irving.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is a childhood acquaintance and friend of Irving. Their relationship dates back to their younger years.

- Friend of — childhood acquaintance  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) is Irving's wife, following a period where the two resumed their romantic involvement and walked together during their courtship. The pair had previously endured a broken engagement in their past before rekindling their bond and eventually getting married in a garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before departing together.

- Romantically involved with — taking a walk together while courting  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
- Spouse of — fiancé/husband  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--paul-irving.md)

Irving is the father of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Their family dynamic is tied into Irving's romance, with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) being involved in discussions surrounding his father's wedding to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md).

- Parent of — father  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001)</sub>
